title: Grade 8 French — Mon, Jun 16
description: Le futur simple — Day 1 of 5: Formation with regular -er and -ir verbs
subject: french

questions.question: The futur simple is formed by taking the _____ and adding endings.
options: infinitive (keeping it as is for -er and -ir verbs)
questions.explanation: For regular -er and -ir verbs, the futur simple stem = the infinitive. Then add: -ai, -as, -a, -ons, -ez, -ont.

questions.question: What are the futur simple endings added to the infinitive?
questions.explanation: Futur simple endings: -ai, -as, -a, -ons, -ez, -ont. These are the same as the present tense of avoir (except -ons/-ez).

questions.question: Conjugate 'parler' in the futur simple for 'je'.
questions.explanation: parler (infinitive) + -ai = je parlerai. The -er ending stays; add -ai for je.

questions.question: What is 'tu parleras' in English?
questions.explanation: parleras = parler + -as (futur simple tu form) = 'you will speak'.

questions.question: Complete the futur simple conjugation of 'parler': il/elle _____
questions.explanation: parler + -a = il/elle parlera. The -a ending marks the 3rd person singular future.

questions.question: Conjugate 'parler' for 'nous' in the futur simple.
questions.explanation: parler + -ons = nous parlerons. Note: the -ons ending looks like present tense but with the infinitive stem, not the present stem.

questions.question: What is the 'vous' form of 'parler' in the futur simple?
questions.explanation: parler + -ez = vous parlerez. Compare with present: vous parlez. Future adds the full infinitive + -ez.

questions.question: Complete: 'ils/elles _____' (parler, futur simple).
questions.explanation: parler + -ont = ils/elles parleront. The -ont ending is used for 3rd person plural future.

questions.question: Now with -ir verbs. Conjugate 'finir' for 'je' in the futur simple.
questions.explanation: finir (infinitive) + -ai = je finirai. -ir verbs keep the full infinitive as stem.

questions.question: What is 'nous finirons'?
questions.explanation: finirons = finir + -ons (futur simple nous form) = 'we will finish'.

questions.question: Choose the correct futur simple form: 'ils _____ (choisir)'.
questions.explanation: choisir + -ont = ils choisiront. Regular -ir verb: full infinitive + -ont.

questions.question: Translate: 'Demain, je mangerai une pizza.'
options: Tomorrow, I will eat a pizza.
Tomorrow, I am eating a pizza.
I used to eat pizza tomorrow.
questions.explanation: mangerai = je + manger + -ai (futur simple). 'Demain' (tomorrow) signals future tense. 'I will eat a pizza tomorrow.'

questions.question: Which sentence uses the futur simple correctly?
options: Je travaille demain soir. (present for near future)
questions.explanation: Elles travailleront = travailler + -ont (3rd plural futur simple). This is the correct futur simple form.

questions.question: What time expressions often go with the futur simple?
options: demain, la semaine prochaine, dans un mois, bientôt (future)
questions.explanation: Future time markers: demain (tomorrow), la semaine prochaine (next week), dans un mois (in a month), bientôt (soon), l'année prochaine (next year).
